people.name: Hananiah
people.line: A false prophet who opposed Jeremiah's prophecies.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in Yahweh’s house,
translations.bsb: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
